overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the posted topic "Discuss/Vote for Town Administrator" was specific enough to alert the public to candidate discussion, though a footnote suggested more detail would have helped.

allegations.summary: Complaint said the notice topic 'Discuss/Vote for Town Administrator' for the Nov. 20, 2013 meeting was too vague, implying a vote rather than interviews.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the topic was sufficiently specific to reasonably advise members of the public that the Board would be discussing the town administrator candidates.
